PST.summary: Huma's PayFi Strategy Token: Solana pool lending to cross-border payment institutions, mostly through the affiliated originator Arf; the Ethereum token is a Chainlink CCIP burn/mint copy, so redemption goes back through Solana; priced by Huma's own NAV oracle.
PST.grade_rule: stated in the issuer's own documents (official = false: a third-party page), not verifiable on chain; the quote is re-checked on the page by offchain.py

relations.relation: Huma names this address as the PST contract on Ethereum

evidence.quote: PST contract on ETH mainnet: 0x22aE3D9a738471f405169Af055d31c687087d4c7

relations.entity: Huma Global Ltd. (BVI) and Arf, one group
relations.relation: The operator and the main originator are affiliated under one corporate group

evidence.quote: The operator, Huma Global Ltd. (BVI), and the dominant credit originator, Arf (Arf Financial GmbH in Switzerland, with a Liechtenstein-domiciled special-purpose vehicle, Arf Capital Ltd.), are affiliated entities combined under a common corporate group (00 Holdings Inc.) in 2024.

relations.relation: Bankruptcy-remote asset protection, separate from the issuer

evidence.quote: Huma Global Ltd. (BVI) is the issuer; the PayFi Foundation (Cayman Islands) provides the bankruptcy-remote asset protection

relations.relation: Main originator: settlement liquidity for licensed payment institutions

evidence.quote: Huma’s primary vertical, powered by its Swiss-regulated entity Arf, provides settlement liquidity to licensed financial institutions and money service businesses, enabling T+0 cross-border settlements.

relations.relation: Most of the pool is lent to Arf-originated credit: close to one originator

evidence.quote: The large majority of pool capital is deployed into Arf-originated credit.

relations.relation: Arf is a VQF member for anti-money-laundering

evidence.quote: Arf Financial GmbH is a Member Of The VQF Self-Regulatory Organization (VQF SRO Member Nr. 101012) for combating money laundering and preventing terrorism financing.

relations.relation: The SRO membership covers AML only: no capital or balance-sheet supervision of the originator

evidence.quote: The originator holds only a Swiss self-regulatory (VQF SRO) membership, which covers anti-money-laundering obligations but provides no prudential supervision, balance-sheet oversight, or capital-adequacy requirement

relations.relation: Borrowers: payment institutions drawing short-term financing to pre-fund settlement corridors (names not disclosed)

evidence.quote: PST's yield depends on repayment by licensed payment institutions drawing short-term financing to pre-fund settlement corridors.

relations.relation: Each credit is repaid within days, backed by funds already in safeguarding accounts

evidence.quote: Each transactional credit is repaid within 1 to 7 days and backed by funds already deposited into safeguarding accounts.

relations.relation: Cross-border prefunding, trade finance, settlement liquidity, card receivables (no split published)

evidence.quote: including cross-border prefunding, trade finance, settlement liquidity, and credit card receivable financing

relations.relation: Trade-finance originator: physical commodities and goods in transit (30 to 90 days)

evidence.quote: Partnering with TradeFlow Capital Management, a Singapore-headquartered specialized investment advisor, Huma finances physical commodities and goods in transit.

relations.relation: Marketplace payout financing partner

evidence.quote: Partnering with Geoswift, Huma accelerates marketplace sellers’ payouts with stablecoin liquidity available on demand

relations.relation: Credits are backed by funds in custody accounts; the bank or custodian is not named

evidence.quote: Huma says these transactional credits generally turn over within one to seven days and are backed by funds already placed in custody accounts.

relations.relation: Redemption is processed off chain: usually 1 business day, up to 7 days
relations.notes: Solana pool; an Ethereum holder must first bridge back through CCIP (not stated by Huma)

evidence.quote: Most redemptions are completed **within 1 business day**, though it may take up to **7 days**, per our service-level agreement (SLA).

relations.relation: A global daily cap applies to redemptions (value not published)

evidence.quote: To maintain protocol stability, Huma enforces a **global daily redemption cap**.

relations.relation: An off-chain job pays requests all-or-nothing and pauses when the pool lacks funds

evidence.quote: Processing redemption requests in an all-or-nothing manner—if the pool lacks sufficient funds to cover a request in full, processing will pause until enough funds are available.

relations.relation: The operator can freeze or cap redemptions; the liquidity sleeve sits in Solana money markets

evidence.quote: A liquidity sleeve (roughly 10–20% of assets) is held in liquid Solana venues to service redemptions, but the operator retains the authority to freeze or cap redemptions

relations.relation: The redemption liquidity sleeve is deposited in Solana money markets

evidence.quote: The redemption liquidity sleeve is deployed into Jupiter Lend and Kamino, the most liquid Solana money markets.

relations.relation: Secondary exit by swap on Solana, while liquidity lasts

evidence.quote: **LPs can redeem instantly by swapping via the PST-USDC pool on Jupiter / Meteora**, as long as sufficient liquidity is available.

relations.relation: The curator of these Morpho vaults also provides secondary liquidity for PST

evidence.quote: We also provide ongoing secondary liquidity for PST, helping ensure market depth and stability.

relations.relation: PST exits through RockawayX's RFQ platform (stated capacity)

evidence.quote: was integrated into RockawayX’s RFQ platform with up to $20M capacity to make looping safer for large liquidity providers

relations.relation: Exclusive bridge for PST from Solana; the Ethereum token is a CCIP burn/mint copy

evidence.quote: chose to adopt the Chainlink Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol (CCIP) as its exclusive bridging infrastructure for its core yield product (PST) and all future yield products

relations.relation: Chainlink oracles price PST on Ethereum

evidence.quote: The integration is supported by Chainlink, whose oracles provide institutional-grade pricing for PST

relations.relation: Huma runs its own off-chain service that tracks the PST price (NAV of private credit)
relations.notes: Sentora: an internally operated oracle, not an independent feed

evidence.quote: A dedicated service that tracks the price of $PST in real time.

relations.relation: Third-party dashboard on asset exposure and performance

evidence.quote: PST is also independently verified by Accountable, which provides third-party assurance on asset exposure and performance with near real-time visibility.

relations.relation: Monthly attestations, cross-checked against on-chain proofs

evidence.quote: Verification uses onchain proofs, cross-checked against monthly attestations by Swiss audit firm Wadsack.

relations.relation: No independent loan-tape audit, trustee or credit rating

evidence.quote: no independent loan-tape audit, trustee, or credit rating has been evidenced

relations.relation: Audit of Huma's EVM contracts (not the CCIP PST token itself)

evidence.quote: **EVM** smart contracts audited by **Spearbit**

relations.relation: Defaults are handled semi-manually by a credit agent of the same group

evidence.quote: defaults are handled semi-manually by the credit agent

relations.relation: The first-loss cover is small

evidence.quote: First-loss cover on the relevant pool is modest (on the order of a couple of percent).

relations.relation: Owner keys can pause the protocol and change pool parameters

evidence.quote: Protocol-owner keys can pause the protocol and change pool parameters
